ability.from: On every dungeon Spin while alive, I gain 1 Poison. Poison ticks each Spin and clears all Poison on tick (can restack). When I Attack, you gain Poison equal to mine.
ability.to: On Spin, I gain 1 Poison. When I Attack, you gain Poison equal to mine.
